title: Kejriwal's 'Sheesh Mahal' to guest house: Delhi govt may rope in private firm to run bungalow
summary: The Delhi government plans to convert Arvind Kejriwal's former residence into a state guest house. A private hospitality firm may operate and maintain the bungalow for revenue generation.
